observes: AUDITD, one ledger commit per case with a relationship qualifier of n chars, then every reader: plain 1,000,000 / 1,800,000 / 3,000,000 / 3,600,000 and 1,000,000 double quotes: commit ok; get_revision and reconstruct return the exact value (length+SHA-256), history ok, export_reconstruction contains it, verify 'equal'; save_snapshot + replacing restore_snapshot: get_revision exact, edge row qualifier exact, verify 'equal'; EraseNodes then redact(prefix) complete (4 records tombstoned, 1 metadata cleared) and the value is gone from get_revision. 1,900,000 double quotes and 700,000 x \\x01 (JSON escaping past 3,641,144) are refused at commit with LedgerInconsistencyError '<MAXSTRING> QualsJson+12^Graph.KG.LedgerApply.1' (a length limit reported as an inconsistency, F-C1107; state after the refusal not re-read in this run). No accepted record that a reader of 11/13/14/18 cannot return
